Been using it every night for months!. I’m a welder/drummer so after long days I usually have a bit of a ring going on in my ears when I try to fall asleep. I learned about different colour noises and found out they have healthy mental relaxation benefits more so than just a simple fan. I started using YouTube to run brown noise but I didn’t like the idea of my phone screen running all night and also I discovered that YouTube compresses audio during the uploading process of videos so I wasn’t getting the full spectrum of brown noise like I thought I was. I then went in search of an app and found ColorSleep. I found it very intuitive and found very quickly that I prefer green noise over brown which I never would’ve known if I didn’t get this app. It’s honestly improved my quality of sleep amazingly. I always pack my portable speaker when I have to sleep anywhere else just for this. Definitely would recommend to any person that suffers from anxiety, insomnia and/or tinnitus.
